instruction: Select the small settings (gear) icon above the right end of the To box. Choose Use dynamic content.
title: Animation: switch the To box from the people picker to dynamic content with the gear
intro: Press Play to watch step 1: the gear above To, then Use dynamic content.

steps.caption: To opens a people picker. Select the small gear above the right end of the To box.
To is now a plain box. Click into it, select the lightning bolt and pick Email.
